open_points.subject: A01 rule 5 vs A16 rule 1 request-check order
open_points.text: A01 rule 5: "This check comes before every other check of the request." A16 rule 1: "A request is handled in this order ... size ... token ... known operation and fits schema ... actor may call ... then the operation's own checks".
open_points.question: For slot/flow creation requests, does the purpose check run before global surface checks (size/token/schema/authorization), or only before other operation-specific checks?
options: Purpose check is truly first across all checks
Purpose check is first only within the operation's own checks after A16 prechecks
open_points.default_guess: Purpose check is first only within operation-specific checks, after A16 prechecks.

open_points.subject: A08 rule 7 binding acceptance revalidation scope
open_points.text: A08 rule 7: "a proposed one is read against the manifest as rule 6 does" and also "when a check fails — in the order rule 5 lists them". Rule 6 excludes instance checks ("not those of the instance, which are A09 rule 6's own"), while rule 5 includes instance-related checks.
open_points.question: When accepting a proposed binding, are instance-selection/header checks from rule 5 rechecked, or only the record/invocability/digest checks of rule 6?
options: Acceptance rechecks full rule-5 list including instance checks

open_points.subject: A04 rule 1 trial-case port matching strictness
open_points.text: A04 rule 1: "added only when its input values fit the contract version's input ports, its expected outputs, when present, fit the output ports".
open_points.question: Does "fit" require an exact port set (no missing and no extra ports), or can extra unnamed ports be ignored/refused under another rule?
options: Exact match required; any missing or extra port is refused
Only declared ports are validated; extras are ignored
Missing refused, extras refused only if schema layer rejects unknown fields
open_points.default_guess: Exact match required; missing or extra ports are refused.

open_points.subject: Size ceilings for `many` value ports at run/trial input
open_points.text: A12 rule 1: "for a `many` port, is a JSON array whose every element fits it — and is within `stored_value_bytes_max`"; A04 rule 1: "every value is within `stored_value_bytes_max`".
open_points.question: For a `many` value port, is `stored_value_bytes_max` enforced on the whole array value, on each element, or both?
options: Both whole array and each element
open_points.default_guess: Enforce on the whole array value bytes.
